item.tib: spyi khyab nam mkha' yangs pa'i mdzod las 'phro 'du rnam pa bzhi yi las tshogs yid la dpal ster
item.coloph: zhes dbal gshen me phreng chen po'i las bzhi'i 'phro 'du zhes bya ba 'di ni kun grol skyes phreng drug pa hUM chen 'gro 'dul gling pas rigs bzhi'i nang tshan lho gnas bam brag brtsegs pa'i mthil mtsho steng bde ldan gling du gtan la phab ste yi ge byed po dge brtson rin chen bkra shis gyis bgyis pa dge des smin grol nam mkha'i khyon kun khyab cing dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/
